name: Amino acid powder, EAA or BCAA
identity: Essential or branched-chain amino acid drink powder, 64 to 83 g amino acids declared as protein per 100 g; sold flavoured.
rule: Per 100 g, each value is the median of the three labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three labels declare it (flavoured by nature). Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from Open Food Facts through Akari's proxy, as the beef protein isolate was.
